name: @pipeworx/mcp-troostwijk

tools.name: troostwijk_categories
tools.description: List Troostwijk Auctions' category tree (industrial equipment, vehicles, real estate, construction, metalworking, woodworking, transport and more) with the category_path each one needs for troostwijk_search_lots / troostwijk_sold_comps. Sourced from troostwijkauctions.com's own navigation menu.

tools.name: troostwijk_search_lots
tools.description: Browse CURRENTLY-OPEN lots in one Troostwijk Auctions category — European industrial equipment, vehicles, real estate and bankruptcy/insolvency liquidations across NL/DE/BE/UK/PL/RO/IT and more. Returns live current bid, bid count, location and close time per lot. Get category_path from troostwijk_categories first. Bids are served through a 5-minute result cache, so the current bid can be up to five minutes old: near the close of an auction treat it as a lower bound, never as the final price. Sourced from troostwijkauctions.com/en/c/{category_path}.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter by lot location, e.g. "nl", "de", "be"

page.description: Result page, starting at 1 (each page holds up to 48 lots)

tools.name: troostwijk_lot_detail
tools.description: Full detail for one Troostwijk lot within its auction: auction description, current/final bid, sale outcome, bid count, location. auction_slug comes from a search/sold-comps result url (the part after /en/a/); pass display_id to pick a specific lot out of a multi-lot auction (omit for a single-lot auction). Bids are served through a 5-minute result cache, so the current bid can be up to five minutes old: near the close of an auction treat it as a lower bound, never as the final price. Sourced from troostwijkauctions.com/en/a/{auction_slug}.

display_id.description: Optional specific lot display id within a multi-lot auction, e.g. "A1-46249-6" (from a search result's display_id field)

tools.name: troostwijk_sold_comps
tools.description: Realized sale-price comps from Troostwijk Auctions' recently-closed auctions. VERIFIED: closed lots with saleTerm CLOSED_RESERVE_PRICE_ALLOCATED or GUARANTEED_SALE_CLOSED carry a real hammer price in current_bid, and this tool returns ONLY those (outcome:"sold") — reserve-not-met, declined and still-pending lots are filtered out, never reported as a price. Scans recently-closed auctions (bounded by max_auctions) and optionally filters by a keyword in the lot title and/or country. Sourced from troostwijkauctions.com/en/auctions?auctionBiddingStatuses=BIDDING_CLOSED plus each matching auction's lot list.

query.description: Optional keyword to match against lot titles, e.g. "generator", "tractor" (case-insensitive substring; seller-written titles may be in the source country's language)

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter closed auctions by location, e.g. "nl", "de", "be"

max_auctions.description: How many recently-closed auctions to scan for sold lots, 1-10 (default 5). Higher finds more matches but costs more upstream requests per call.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-troostwijk forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the troostwijk pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
